Plan.Title: Daggerheart
Plan.Hint: How the GM runs this fight: the Fear it starts with, and how freely it spends Fear to bring more adversaries into the spotlight.
Plan.FearHint: The Fear the GM has going in. It starts as the world's Fear, and Make it So writes back what the fight leaves.
Plan.SpendingHint: On a GM turn, one adversary takes the spotlight. The GM can spend a Fear for each one more.
Plan.sparingHint: One more adversary in a GM turn, only while the GM holds more than 4 Fear.
Plan.steadyHint: One more adversary in a GM turn, while the GM holds more than 1 Fear.
Plan.freeHint: As many more adversaries as there is Fear for.
